## Most Ligue 1 Titles Won by an Italian Player
Summarized by Meta AI
50 people talking about this
Marco Verratti holds the record for an Italian player with 9 Ligue 1 titles, all won with Paris Saint-Germain between 2013 and 2023. Gianluigi Buffon is another Italian with a Ligue 1 title, winning it once with PSG in the 2017-18 season.
Marco Verratti’s 9 Ligue 1 Titles with PSG
Italian midfielder Marco Verratti is the Italian player with the most Ligue 1 championships. He won nine titles during PSG’s dominant run from 2013 to 2023, making him one of the two players with the most Ligue 1 titles overall.

Gianluigi Buffon’s Single Ligue 1 Championship
Legendary Italian goalkeeper Gianluigi Buffon won one Ligue 1 title during his time at PSG in the 2017-18 season. It’s part of a trophy haul that also includes 10 Serie A titles in Italy.

Other Italian Players with Ligue 1 Experience
While Verratti and Buffon are the main Italian names linked to Ligue 1 titles, other Italians like Michel Platini won the French league earlier in his career with Saint-Étienne in 1980-81. Most Italian players with multiple league titles have won them in Serie A rather than Ligue 1.
